# Copilot Instructions

The authoritative, always-on guidance for this repository lives in
[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

**Read `AGENTS.md` before making changes.** It is the single source of truth for:

- Toolchain and versions (mise, ansible-core, ansible-lint, yamllint, molecule).
- Project structure and the custom `mikeeq.*` collections.
- How to run playbooks (always `--check --diff` first).
- Linting, pre-commit, and tests.
- Conventions and safety rules (`.yaml` only, never run as root, quoting, line length).

Do not duplicate that content here — update `AGENTS.md` instead.
